about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Evoque D150 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Evoque D150 has been part of the Range Rover Evoque range since 2016, using the Ingenium family of 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engines. It replaced the earlier Ford-derived TD4 unit and brings modern common-rail diesel technology with a focus on efficiency and emissions compliance. The D150 is the entry-level diesel output in the Ingenium range, offering a balance of economy and everyday usability that suits the Evoque's character well.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ150D / AJ200D engines for every Range Rover Evoque D150 on the road.

codes.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Evoque D150 ENGINE

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the Evoque D150 from 2016 to present, spanning both the L538 and L551 generations. Known for timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks over time — see the callout above. We replace timing chains, injector seals, EGR components, and gaskets as standard on every D150 rebuild.
